doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: John McLaughlin's My Goal's Beyond and dating the Elvin Jones tenure
summary: They go through personnel of My Goal's Beyond and use dates to place Genesis and the start of his time with Elvin.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: This is with the forerunner of Mahavishnu, Jerry Goodman, Billy Cobham, but then . . .
It is, yep. And then Badal’s there.
Charlie Haden is on it. Airto [Moreira] is on it.
I don’t know. I don’t remember that.
I haven’t heard that record, but I’m sure it’s interesting.

That’s a beautiful record. The second side was solo guitar. The first side was these two tunes Indian-ish, and the second side was the –he did Blue in Green great, and solo guitar. Very unusual at that time for a modern.
Next is Genesis. We’ve talked about that.
Then I joined Elvin in September of ’71. That takes care of that. So I was with Elvin a year and a half, because I was with him until January of ’73.
